description: Products and pages RivalSweeper first found on each brand's site (sitemaps and catalog feeds) in the last N days, newest first, interleaved across brands. Shopify variant URLs are folded into their product, and a product that only gained new sizes/colours is labelled so. Each item has its tags (names), first_seen (when RivalSweeper first found it: usually within a day of publication, not the brand's own publish date) and sitemap_lastmod when the sitemap gives one; per-brand counts come first. Pages found in a brand's first days of tracking are left out (they existed before). Default last 7 days, up to 50 items (max 200).

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

name: get_newly_published_products_and_pages
